text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This happened when I visited 
the academy store with Phalaenopsis.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Oho, hiyashiame? 
They sell quite intriguing things. Shall I 
buy one—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it is the shifting weather. 
I believe they said today's day-to-night 
temperature swing would be severe.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I shall settle for warm tea for now. 
As for the hiyashiame... *sigh*. Next 
time, then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to drink something cold because of 
her headache, 
Phalaenopsis looked rather disappointed...
